red_lines.scope: Lower A/B source has reversed closed-cavity semantics; waist/hip A/B has16 duplicated rows; F1/E2a four inherited trays have positive inner boundaries. Earlier source statistics are not qualified physical inventories.
red_lines.close_when: Single-source finite material preserves signed cavities, every physical member has a unique identity and counted functional ownership, net material/COM/inertia are independently recomputed. No absent-member union mass rows or unsupported dedup credits.

red_lines.scope: Corrected critical material intersections remain positive. Zero-eye deficit improvement does not establish assembly. Waist/hip B moves axis without matched cylinder stroke eligibility.
red_lines.close_when: A complete fixed/output/bearing/actuator chain has legal nonintersecting material, actual assembly interfaces, full stroke and continuous sweep inside declared shell limits.

red_lines.scope: 5mm lower arch discontinuity, missing four low hip-roll-eye reaction bridges and complete shoulder bridge. Pressure tube/pin/rod analytic sensitivities do not qualify connections, guide stability, fatigue or true contact.
red_lines.close_when: Actual independent serial force paths and connections exist; task-consistent reactions, pressure extremes, material/heat treatment, bearing/contact, buckling, stiffness and fatigue are qualified within declared scope.

red_lines.scope: No complete F2 robot, new force distribution, continuous drive, installed fluid routes, whole mass/inertia, power/regeneration or thermal working point. Gross chamber force is not a joint or robot rating.
red_lines.close_when: Installable modules reconnect to whole body and actual system inventory; same-version task loads, speed/pressure/flow, continuous drive, electrical/return energy and heat close before SI handoff.

yellow_lines.scope: Custom load shells, cylinders, bearing installation and electrical/hydraulic supply remain unselected. Procurement may remain open; physical evidence may not.
yellow_lines.close_when: Declare credible complete size/mass/output/thermal ranges and pass their physical checks; selecting a procurement model is deferred.
